| Value | Mean photons | Photon spread | Noise in levels |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 | 1.96 | 1.400 | 7.14 |
| 128 | 25.10 | 5.010 | 25.55 |
| 255 | 50 | 7.071 | 36.06 |

With 50 photons at white, a value of 128 has a mean of 25.10 photons. A Poisson count has a standard deviation equal to the square root of its mean. Scaled back by 255 / 50, that is the noise in levels. The bright value has more noise in levels, but less relative to its value.
